Max and Mia are looking at frogs in their backyard.

They want to know more about the stages of a frog's life.

Explore Max’s and Mia's questions:

1. What are the different physical characteristics of a tadpole, a froglet, and an adult frog?
2. What is the link between the changes in a frog's physical characteristics and its habitat? 

Share your ideas using the Documentation tool.

Use the bricks:

Build a model of a tadpole.
Document your model through a photograph or sketch.

Use the bricks:

Continue to build your model, showing how it changes from a tadpole into a froglet.

Document your new model through a photograph or sketch, and make a note about the changes reflected in your new model.
<font size="3">Program your froglet to move around its habitat.</font>

Turn on the Smarthub and connect it to your device. Watch the video if you need help.

Refer to the Help panel for more guidance.

Use your model:

Make changes to your froglet so it represents an adult frog.

Consider all of the following:
1. Change its appearance.
2. Change the way it moves.
3. Change its behaviour to represent an adult frog.

Document the changes you make to your model, and explain why this happens in nature.

Finalise your document:

1. Examine one of the models that you have built and documented. What are the limitations of your model?
2. Organise your information.
3. Insert important text, pictures, screenshots or videos to demonstrate specific evidence that your model represents the life cycle of a frog.

Share your findings:

Use your model and your own words to make a presentation about the life cycle of a frog. 

Be sure to point out specific examples of how your model represents a frog's life cycle. 

Share at least one limitation of your model.

Use your model further 
with Max and Mia

How do frogs morph during their lives?

In this project, you will:
• Explore what you know about the stages in the life cycle of a frog, from birth to adult.
• Create and program a model of a young frog and an adult frog.
• Document the changing characteristics of your model throughout different stages of a frog's life.

Use your model further:

The changes that a frog experiences throughout its life cycle are influenced by its environment.

Choose one of the following influences and use the bricks to model and describe the related effect on your frog: 
1. Change in habitat
2. Pollution or disease 

Document the effect of this external factor on the life of your frog.
